# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 7 priority parameter families have provenance metadata: AOB/NOB/comammox (6 param_meta entries), carbonate constants (4 code-resident constants with doc-comment provenance + PROVENANCE_STATUS.md coverage), denitrification (5 param_meta entries replacing the former self-referencing TODO), shrimp reproduction (4 threshold/suppression param_meta entries), shrimp molt minerals (5 param_meta entries including ca/mg/gh weights), chloride-nitrite protection factor (1 param_meta entry), plant/algae growth (4 param_meta entries).
- Confidence tiers are explicit and machine-readable: 19 process param_meta entries and 15 shrimp param_meta entries each specify confidence as literature/expert/heuristic/placeholder. PROVENANCE_STATUS.md opens with tier definitions.
- Enriched TOML files load through standard serde deserialization with no special-case hacks. param_meta is optional via serde defaults. ParamMetaPreset trait validates unknown keys are rejected. Multiple roundtrip and loading tests confirm clean schema compliance.
- Developer-facing summary (docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md, 172 lines) distinguishes strong anchors (literature-backed stoichiometric and Monod constants) from provisional approximations (heuristic plant growth rates, placeholder low_temp_repro_ramp_width_c). Includes 'How to Use This Summary' section and lists pending annotations.
- Representative enriched files exist for each parameter family: default.toml (process/nitrogen kinetics), neocaridina_davidi.toml (shrimp), hard_shrimp.toml and moderate.toml (source-water), active_planted.toml and coarse_porous.toml (substrate).
- Prior final-review amendments fully resolved: denitrification TODO(tanksim-6e5.7.2) replaced with 5 formal param_meta entries; tan_repro_full_suppression_mg_n_per_l and no2_repro_full_suppression_mg_n_per_l now have heuristic-confidence param_meta with derivation rationale.
- All tests pass: 37 tank_data, 16 tank_scenarios, 11 tank_core. Clippy clean across all three packages. Dedicated regression tests lock denitrification metadata coverage, shrimp suppression-endpoint coverage, source-water priority tiers, substrate colonizable-area metadata, and scenario denitrification field mapping.

## Findings and Gaps

- soft_acidic.toml and ro_like.toml source-water profiles lack per-parameter param_meta (documented in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md as lower priority; representative coverage met via hard_shrimp.toml and moderate.toml).
- inert_sand.toml and inert_gravel.toml substrate files lack colonizable_area_factor param_meta (representative coverage met via active_planted.toml and coarse_porous.toml).
- Carbonate solver constants (pKa1, pKa2, K_H) use doc-comment provenance rather than param_meta, since they are code-resident constants not TOML-loaded presets. This is documented as an intentional design choice in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md.
- Process routing fractions (assimilation, respiration, excretion splits) and thermal transport constants are listed as pending future annotation in PROVENANCE_STATUS.md.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
